All signs.voice_body: OPEN UP to the quiet clarity that arrives when Mercury trines the True Node on 30 September 2026. This gentle alignment signals that the way you think—your ideas, questions, and conversations—will naturally point toward your higher purpose. It’s a soft push from the mind to the soul, not a thunderclap of change. Imagine your morning coffee conversation flowing into a meaningful project; that’s the pattern. The symbolic meaning is: communication becomes a compass, guiding you toward growth. Embrace this by writing a short note about one insight you want to pursue and share it with a friend or colleague. The support aspect is the ease of dialogue; use it to articulate goals, ask for feedback, and let your thoughts align with your aspirations. Take action today: draft that note and send it.
